insights.title: AI Model Wars Intensify with Claude Opus 5, Gemini 3.6 Flash, and Kimi K3 Dominating July 2026
insights.summary: Three major frontier model releases in a single week signal the industry's pivot from parameter arms races to practical efficiency. Claude Opus 5 offers near Fable 5 at half price, Gemini 3.6 Flash cuts costs 17% while improving performance, and Moonshot's Kimi K3 at 2.8T parameters approaches frontier benchmarks at 1/3 the cost.

insights.title: Computer-Use Agent Infrastructure Plays Emerge as Key Investment Theme
insights.summary: With Prentis ($100M round for computer-use models), JetBrains Air ACP support, and AMD's physical AI focus converging, there's an opportunity in building specialized agent tooling — either a vertical automation platform or infrastructure layer for multi-agent workflows.
